closing_odds.note: Last observed live quote within 6 minutes of scheduled kickoff, market age <=120 seconds. Local timestamps are not independently attested and actual kickoff delays are unknown. Offered quote CLV is not realized execution CLV or guaranteed official closing odds. Missing quotes stay missing.

evidence.assessment: Forward evidence collection; improvements are not assumed from software or data changes.

benchmark_forward_experiment.note: Primary 1X2 log loss; week-block bootstrap, one preregistered candidate. Calibration and subgroup metrics are descriptive. Ready means enough evidence to review, including negative findings; it does not mean approval or profitability. Baseline is the actual production forecast. No closing odds, backfill, bets or automatic promotion.

filter_sensitivity_experiment.note: One unit per simulated selection, net of frozen costs; simultaneous kickoff P&L grouped for drawdown. First eligible fixture snapshot freezes all policies and rejections. Different policies may select different markets/cohorts; results are not paired probability tests. Four weeks or 30 selections do not establish profitability. No automatic promotion; validate a chosen policy on later untouched data.

goal_blend_experiment.note: Uncalibrated fixed variants; paired samples; no betting policy, ROI or promotion.

market_led_experiment.note: Paper results at feed odds, not realized returns. Costs are user-configured per stake. Late reference proxy uses only archived quotes 20–60 minutes before kickoff; not actual closing odds. No automatic collection at close or promotion.

settings_observed.selection: one market per fixture; at most ten fixtures

model_reliability_experiment.note: Two separate one-factor trials against actual production, not a combined configuration. First eligible snapshot freezes missing candidates too. Primary 1X2 week-block intervals use 97.5% per trial (familywise 95%); other markets/calibration are guardrails and descriptive. No automatic promotion or betting-edge claim.

totals_anchor_experiment.note: Separate proportional intensity scaling to fresh Pinnacle O/U 2.5, fitted rho and production HDA preserved. Primary Under 3.5 log loss; other markets are guardrails. No bets, automatic promotion or backfill.
